categoriesExplainer: A category groups series and books in your library. Add one, then put series or books on it.
noCategoriesYetFromMenu: Add one from the menu on the Library or Books screen, under Edit categories.
chooseCategoryName: Choose a name for the category.
categoryContentsStay: The series and books in it stay in your library.
findOnAnotherSource: Find “{title}” on another source. Its categories and your reading progress move with it.
noOtherSource: No other source to move to
installAnotherSource: Install another source that can search, then come back.
seriesLeavesSource: The series leaves {fromName} and moves to {toName}. Your categories and reading progress move with it.
hasNothingCalled: {name} has nothing called “{term}”. Try a shorter title, or another source.
removeSeriesHint: Your reading progress is kept. You can add the series to your library again.
libraryEmptyHint: Add a series with the bookmark button on its page. It stays here with your reading progress.
readEverythingInCategory: You have read everything in this category.
noSeriesInCategory: No series in this category yet. Touch and hold a series to add it to a category.
chaptersOpenedHint: Chapters you open appear here, newest first.
